pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark patches with deeply incised, stellate edge geometries. High-frequency serration and sharp pixel-level gradients are visible at the margins of each contiguous dark region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light tan pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial and quad-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section, becoming narrower toward the lower limb transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane along the upper neck profile displaying a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.
